reason: B is the better proposal because a minor boron substitution is a substantive compositional intervention that could plausibly improve both glass-forming ability and resistance to crystallization, and it can be tested against the parent alloy over matched cooling and reheating schedules. A mainly improves kinetic vitrification during quenching; faster cooling does not inherently improve reheating stability and may leave a less-relaxed, higher-free-volume glass, so its central mechanistic claim is weak.
